locator: Figure 3 and accompanying microscopy results, three independent DOPC/cholesterol sample series.
preparation: Hydrated 4 mM DOPC/cholesterol samples prepared by low-temperature trapping and equilibrated at 23 °C. The microscopy stage temperature is unspecified.
crystal_reference: The microscopy study identifies cholesterol monohydrate. Shaw used hydrated cholesterol crystals at room temperature and did not specify their polymorph.
interpretation: Microscopy detects crystals. At equilibrium with the same crystal reference the activity is one by definition. The reported composition spread has no specified confidence level. No saturation condition was used in either fit to Shaw Table S1.
